Every business identifier a persona states or a seeded record carries is drawn from the difficulty's band below. Persona full names must be unique across the whole scenario: build every patient / dependent / subscriber name from the surnames listed for your difficulty only (given names free, never reuse a full name across your own tasks). Emails use the person's own name at a realistic consumer domain. Employer names (Larkspur at Work enrollments) come only from your list. Every other reference you invent (insurance member_number, group_number, authorization_number, statement_number, payer claim / remittance references, contact numbers) has its numeric part beginning with your two-digit prefix.
